items.title: Finite matrix algebras with the operator norm are C star algebras
items.statement: For every integer n >= 1, M_n(C), with conjugate-transpose involution and the operator norm on C^n, is a unital complex C*-algebra.

references.title: Sheldon Axler, Linear Algebra Done Right, fourth edition, complete author-hosted book
references.locator: Section 7F, printed pp. 280-283 / PDF pp. 293-296: finite-dimensional operator norms, the least-bound characterization, and the norm of an adjoint. The local proof derives the C*-identity directly.

title: Operator-Algebraic States and GNS Representations: Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: Vector and normalized-trace states on matrix algebras
items.statement: For n >= 1, the first-coordinate vector state on M_n(C) has the defining representation as its explicit GNS model; the normalized trace has M_n(C) with normalized Hilbert-Schmidt inner product and left multiplication as its GNS model, and for n >= 2 the trace is non-extreme and its representation is reducible.

references.title: Ilijas Farah, Combinatorial Set Theory of C*-algebras (2019), complete author-hosted book
references.locator: Proposition 1.10.3, printed p. 35: the unital state quotient inner product, left multiplication representation, and cyclic vector.

references.title: Ian F. Putnam, Lecture Notes on C*-algebras (2019), complete author-hosted lecture notes
references.locator: Section 1.12, Theorem 1.12.4, printed pp. 54-55: the unital state quotient, completion, bounded left action, and unit cyclic vector.

references.title: Sheldon Axler, Linear Algebra Done Right, fourth edition, complete author-hosted book
references.locator: Section 7F, printed pp. 280-283 / PDF pp. 293-296: finite-dimensional operator norms and the norm of an adjoint.
